ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens with ruffled edges and thin reddish-purple stems, scattered across the upper-left and center of a white square plate, covering roughly 35% of the plate surface; leaves look slightly wilted and glossy with moisture, lying flat in a loose heap about 1-2 cm thick | 60
ITEM 2 | Small round green-brown cooked spheres about 2.5-3 cm across, with slightly charred or browned outer surfaces and firm, intact shape, five or six pieces clustered near the center and one at the lower edge of the plate | 70
ITEM 3 | Small diced orange pieces about 1 cm cubes, bright orange with matte, slightly moist surface, three pieces visible, two near the center-right of the leafy pile and one at the lower right | 8
ITEM 4 | A single reddish-stemmed green leaf, about 8-10 cm long, lying alone at the lower left of the plate with one small round green-brown sphere resting on it | 12
